title: Question 17
passage:
These name cards are hard to read across the table.
A. I can keep the type size and use thicker paper. B. We set aside a seat for each guest. C. I’ll make the names bigger before reprinting them.
passageZh:
從桌子對面很難看清這些桌牌。
A. 我可以維持字級，改用厚一點的紙。
B. 我們為每位來賓留了一個座位。
C. 我把姓名的字放大，再重印一套。
